header: Everything we do with your staff data, in one list
lead: A rota system holds names, hours, absence reasons and sometimes health data. This is the whole of what we do with it, written so a works council can read it.

items.title: Hosted in Vienna
items.text: Primary and replica both sit inside the European Union, with no processing outside it.

items.title: Encrypted in transit and at rest
items.text: TLS 1.3 on every connection, AES-256 on disk, and encrypted backups held for 35 days.

items.title: Role-based access
items.text: Managers see their own branch. Payroll sees figures. Nobody sees an absence reason without a reason of their own.

items.title: Every read is logged
items.text: Access to an individual's record is recorded, and the log is available to the works council on request.

items.title: Deletion on a schedule
items.text: Personal data goes at the end of the statutory retention period unless you tell us otherwise, and we tell you before it does.

items.title: A processing agreement you can read
items.text: Eleven pages, no annexes that point at other annexes, and no subprocessor added without notice.

items.title: Independently tested
items.text: A penetration test every twelve months by a firm we do not choose, with the summary sent to every customer.

items.title: Your data leaves with you
items.text: CSV and JSON within five working days of a request, including the audit trail.
